item.title: About
item.description:
Hello!

My name is Gourav, also known as Optional.

I started this blog in 2026 to share my journey into cybersecurity and talk about topics that interest me.

If you’re starting out in cybersecurity or curious about ethical hacking, whether for fun or as a career, I hope you’ll find something helpful here.

Currently, I have been working in cybersecurity for 2 years.
